summary: Two-square parametrisation p=a²+b² (a odd, b even) for p≤10⁶: the least Type I index minI depends only on p mod 8 among the (a mod 8, b mod 8) classes tested: for p≡5 (mod 8) minI=3 for every prime (mean 3.000); for p≡1 (mod 8) minI>7 in ~8–10% of primes, with no further split by (a,b) mod 8. So the deterministic rule over (a mod 8, b mod 8) reduces to the 2-adic class.
not_done: Rule search beyond mod 8 in (a,b) not run.
next: Search residues of a,b mod 3,5,7 within p≡1 (mod 8) for a rule predicting minI>7.
